data.body: 67aa round-6 IND1 remediation: reviewer correctly caught that the emitter's case input is a model-free provenance descriptor (not plan text), so running the Pass-1 finder on it cannot elicit a real fire/no-fire verdict. FIX: the admission runner now REHYDRATES each case's finder input from the review sidecar record — loads corpus.build_corpus verified rows (description/children keyed by review_event_uuid), joins each selector-manifest candidate by review_event_uuid, and runs run_case with case[input]=rehydrated description (plus children for container criteria). A candidate resolving to no verified sidecar row is withheld to drift as unrecoverable material. Admitted spec persists the runnable material as its input. Also grounds drift provenance in (ticket_id, review_event_uuid) from the matched row (resolves A1), and states retry backoff 1s/2s/4s (resolves E2 advisory). Trimmed to 7958 chars (<8000 P4 gate). All round 2-5 remediations preserved. Launching review-plan round 7.
